svg.title: Roller at a glance
svg.desc: Four uses of Roller. Training data: roller export --format sft writes SFT records that keep reasoning, images and compacted-context segments. Benchmarks: roller collect --bench runs seven Harnesses on five benchmarks and grades each sample in its container. Local sessions: roller import turns the Claude Code and Codex sessions on this machine into a run. Datasets: roller export --format hf writes a redacted Hugging Face dataset folder. Every path writes the same run directory, which roller view opens.
